# function: sagemaker_geospatial_raster_data_collection

Builds the ARN for `sagemaker-geospatial` `RasterDataCollection`:

```
arn:${Partition}:sagemaker-geospatial:${Region}:${Account}:raster-data-collection/${CollectionID}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:sagemaker-geospatial:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:raster-data-collection/collection-id
output "sagemaker_geospatial_raster_data_collection" {
  value = provider::arn::sagemaker_geospatial_raster_data_collection("collection-id")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
sagemaker_geospatial_raster_data_collection(collection_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `collection_id` (String) Value for `${CollectionID}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
